title: NY-based Daylight, which provides AI-powered managed security, raised an $80M Series B led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, sources say at a ~$400M valuation (Maria Armental/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Maria Armental / Wall Street Journal: NY-based Daylight, which provides AI-powered managed security, raised an $80M Series B led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, sources say at a ~$400M valuation — The $80 million investment in Daylight Security highlights growing demand for security platforms that pair AI agents with human experts
